summary: A real task service is launched through the resolved session-environment argv with no --port flag and a stale PANOPTICON_PORT=8000 in the parent process, and an authenticated /identity with the resolved instance_id is served on the URL-selected port, so a launcher that failed to derive or pin the port would time out or answer on 8000; the default container callback port is asserted from the URL in both the unit and real tests; the integrated child-environment test proves _start_sessions emits the same pinned port.
